description: Defines interfaces and classes related to providing and managing grain type metadata within Orleans, including mechanisms to associate grain types with classes via attributes.

classes.name: AttributeGrainTypeProvider
classes.description: Provides grain type information for classes via attributes, implementing IGrainTypeProvider.

classes.name: GrainTypeAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute to specify grain type for a class, implementing IGrainTypeProviderAttribute.

methods.name: TryGetGrainType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the GrainType for a given class type.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the GrainType associated with the class, as specified by the attribute.
